findings.function: send, sendWithPermit, quoteSend, quoteOFT (and lzReceive's credit path through the immutable endpoint)
findings.decompiled: require not Mask(224, 32, cd[_param1 + 4]) / revert with Panic(18)
findings.source: OFTCore._debitView -> _removeDust(_amountLD): (_amountLD / decimalConversionRate) * decimalConversionRate, with decimalConversionRate an immutable
findings.issue: solc immutables read as 0 (decimalConversionRate, endpoint, token decimals), so every send/quote path divides by zero and the text of these functions ends in 'revert with Panic(18)' right after argument decoding.

notes: via-IR LayerZero OFT token (16 KB bytecode, 966-line text). Because of the immutable artifact the send/quote functions are short; their prologues (nonReentrant via transient storage, paused, extra-options length check 0xfe9e4f44, AddressZero) match the source up to the division. All functions reviewed in detail. Source loops: 2, whiles: lzReceiveAndRevert's for over packets (884, with the packet decoding and a copy line for the message) and _setEnforcedOptions' for (setEnforcedOptions 807). Implicit loops: the calldata decode of the EnforcedOptionParam[] (777) and the encoding of the stored options bytes (858). Address checks print in the via-IR form 'require not Mask(96, 160, _param2)' (21 lines), next to the 'x == address(x)' form of legacy builds; equivalent. No semantic problem found.
summary: A small, faithful text with both source loops found; most send/quote paths collapse to a division-by-zero revert because the immutable decimal conversion rate reads as 0 in pre-deployment code.
